name: shop-loops
label: BFB Shop loops
job: the shop's query loop types on Bricks' Container, Block and Div (best sellers, related, recently viewed, variations, images, reviews, wishlist, compare, quote, saved for later, orders, order items and totals, product finder, product moments, pin product) and their set controls, with product cards built from Bricks' own elements
